purpose: Register human-readable and structured knowledge assets that LOC7_KM may index, cite, version, and expose through knowledge/search views.
rules: Registration as a knowledge asset does not make every statement Canon.
Each asset keeps its own authority, status, provenance, and version context.
README.md is a maintained system overview and progress/documentation view; it is not the highest-priority Canon source.
Canonical definitions remain governed by their designated mother sources and Canon documents.
